     def __call__(self) -> datetime.datetime:
         return self.time_to_freeze + (real_datetime.now() - self.start)
+
+    def tick(self, delta: Union[datetime.timedelta, float]=datetime.timedelta(seconds=1)) -> datetime.datetime:
+        """Advances time by the specified delta (seconds or timedelta)"""
+        if isinstance(delta, numbers.Integral):
+            self.move_to(self() + datetime.timedelta(seconds=int(delta)))
+        elif isinstance(delta, numbers.Real):
+            self.move_to(self() + datetime.timedelta(seconds=float(delta)))
+        else:
+            # If it's a timedelta, add it to the current time
+            self.move_to(self() + delta)  # type: ignore
+        return self()
 
     def move_to(self, target_datetime: _Freezable) -> None:
         """Moves frozen date to the given ``target_datetime``"""
